result:
833 entries — within the 800–1500 target range. The file is written to `projects/sexual-language-index/data/dump/ta-words.txt`.

Coverage summary:
- **Organs** (clinical + crude): penis, vagina, breasts, testicles, anus, clitoris, uterus, other anatomy
- **Acts**: intercourse, oral, masturbation, anal, ejaculation/orgasm, arousal, positions, violence (clinical)
- **Fluids/states**: semen, vaginal fluid, erection — clinical and slang registers
- **Desire/descriptors**: horny-equivalents, lustful, frigid, prudish
- **Identities**: full clinical set + slurs for gay/lesbian/bi/trans/asexual/intersex
- **Insults**: motherfucker-equivalents, cunt-insults, slut-shaming vocabulary, crude compound expletives
- **Sex work/porn**: classical and modern terms, subgenres
- **Kink/paraphilia**: BDSM vocabulary, fetish categories
- **Euphemisms/idioms**: native Tamil circumlocutions
- **Archaic/literary**: Sangam-era terms, Sanskrit-derived classical vocabulary
- **Internet/modern**: loanwords, online slang, app-era terms
- **Tamil-specific categories**:
  - Sangam love taxonomy (akam/puṟam, five tiṇai landscapes, kaḷavu vs. karpu)
  - Honor/chastity economy (karpu, māṉam, veṭkam system)
  - Third-gender vocabulary (tirunaṅkai, aravāṇi, ali, kōcā lineage)
  - Tantric/religious sexuality (liṅgam/yōṉi worship, devadasi, pañcamakāra)
  - Classical desire terminology (kāmam, mōkam, ūṭal, kūṭal system)
